name: Campingplatz Hiasenhof
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Hiasenhof is located on the quiet edge of Thiersee in the Tyrolean Kaisergebirge. The site offers pitches in an alpine meadow landscape with a view of the surrounding mountains. Guests reach the Thiersee on foot in a few minutes. The facilities include sanitary buildings, a small bread roll service and a barbecue area. The campsite is suitable for peace-seeking nature lovers and hikers.
